selection: lexicographically first complete test groups, all 14 variants per group
locked_use: Held-out diagnostic only; do not tune training, prompts, or checkpoints on these results.
statistical_unit: Original group_id. These rows share test groups with main and each other; do not pool as independent observations.

paraphrase.changes: Question and relevant official-document wording only; source, dates, budget, values, identities, targets and citations are preserved.
paraphrase.unchanged: Community documents, unrelated custom-theme documents, system instruction, split and private gold metadata.
paraphrase.interpretation: A small fixed wording-shift probe, not proof of broad natural-language generalization.

redacted.changes: Original question retained, all visible documents removed, contract target recomputed from observable plan and budget.
redacted.target_policy: Missing plan -> clarify; explicit plan and budget>0 -> search; explicit plan and budget=0 -> abstain.
redacted.interpretation: Evidence-dependence diagnostic, not accuracy against original gold and not a stand-alone SFT gain claim.

metadata_note: diagnostic, variant, group_id, id, target and gold are outside model messages. Variant names describe the source case.
